BiblicalUsage: Nadan is the sheath of a sword, and its only occurrence is the angel putting his sword away. In 1 Chronicles 21:27 the Lord commands the angel, and he puts up his sword again into the sheath, and the plague on Jerusalem stops.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sword going back into the sheath is one of the kindest moments in the Bible; judgment stops when God says stop, and the sheath is the sign of it.
